passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's:
passages.note: Enrolled text requires written notice to a parent of any name/pronoun change request (rung 4) and no longer contains the parental-permission rule, so rung 5 is excluded; its only other part is a related K-3 sexuality-instruction ban, treated as single-subject enough.
Third-reading Yea; the engrossed text voted on is not in the sources, and the later concurrence vote on the enrolled text governs.
passages.actor_quote: Y EA - 65 Aylesworth Haggard Mayfield Slager Baird Hall

passages.provision_quote: An employee or a staff member of a school may only use a name, pronoun, title, or other word to identify a student that is inconsistent with the student's sex if:
passages.note: Committee-amended version with a parental written-request rule; not shown to be the text Hall voted on, and superseded by the enrolled text he concurred in.

rows.reasoning: Hall voted Yea (63-29) to concur in HEA 1608 (2023), whose operative section provides that "A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student" of a student's name or pronoun change request, matching "Require schools to notify parents." The enrolled text dropped the earlier parental written-request rule, so it does not reach "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns," and it notifies regardless of whether parents ask.
